```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

All individuals with more than one CHIP trajectory are analysed together (with the
participant ids of the paper): for every pair of trajectories of
an individual, the Spearman correlation of the two REML curves and of their speeds over the ages both cover, the
correlation of the measured VAFs at shared timepoints, the net direction of each curve, the read-noise test of the
measured VAFs and the pigeonhole bound (2 VAF1 + 2 VAF2 > 1 forces the variants into the same cells). A figure of
three individuals for each of the three patterns is drawn but is not a display item of the paper; Figure S6 shows all individuals.

```{r libraries}
source("R/paper_functions.R")
library(ggrepel)

calls <- load_calls()
pred  <- load_pred()
cl    <- load_final_clusters()
multi <- calls %>% group_by(ID) %>% filter(n_distinct(traj_id) > 1) %>% ungroup()
ids <- multi %>% distinct(ID, SHCS_ID_new) %>% mutate(num = as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new))) %>% arrange(num)
pred_m <- pred %>% filter(traj_id %in% multi$traj_id) %>% inner_join(calls %>% distinct(traj_id, label), by = "traj_id")
cat(nrow(ids), "individuals with more than one trajectory;", n_distinct(multi$traj_id), "trajectories\n")
knitr::kable(multi %>% distinct(SHCS_ID_new, traj_id, Gene.refGene) %>% count(SHCS_ID_new, name = "trajectories") %>% arrange(as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new))))
```

# 1. Pairwise analysis

```{r pairs}
net_direction <- function(v) {
  d <- tail(v, 1) - head(v, 1)
  rng <- max(v) - min(v)
  if (rng < 0.01) return("flat") else if (d > 0.3 * rng) "up" else if (d < -0.3 * rng) "down" else "flat"
}
first_detect <- function(tid) min(multi$Age[multi$traj_id == tid & multi$source != "imputed"])

pair_rows <- list()
for (id in ids$ID) {
  tr <- unique(multi$traj_id[multi$ID == id])
  for (i in seq_along(tr)) for (j in seq_along(tr)) if (i < j) {
    a <- pred_m %>% filter(traj_id == tr[i]) %>% select(Age, VAF, VAF_speed)
    b <- pred_m %>% filter(traj_id == tr[j]) %>% select(Age, VAF, VAF_speed)
    ab <- inner_join(a, b, by = "Age", suffix = c("1", "2"))
    oa <- multi %>% filter(traj_id == tr[i]) %>% select(Age, AF, source, lod_depth)
    ob <- multi %>% filter(traj_id == tr[j]) %>% select(Age, AF, source, lod_depth)
    oab <- inner_join(oa, ob, by = "Age", suffix = c("1", "2")) %>%
      mutate(se = sqrt(AF1 * (1 - AF1) / lod_depth1 + AF2 * (1 - AF2) / lod_depth2), z = (AF1 - AF2) / se)
    r_vaf <- if (nrow(ab) > 2) suppressWarnings(cor(ab$VAF1, ab$VAF2, method = "spearman")) else NA
    r_speed <- if (nrow(ab) > 2) suppressWarnings(cor(ab$VAF_speed1, ab$VAF_speed2, method = "spearman")) else NA
    r_obs <- if (nrow(oab) > 2) suppressWarnings(cor(oab$AF1, oab$AF2, method = "spearman")) else NA
    pair_rows[[length(pair_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      ID = id, traj_1 = tr[i], traj_2 = tr[j],
      variant_1 = calls$label[match(tr[i], calls$traj_id)], variant_2 = calls$label[match(tr[j], calls$traj_id)],
      shared_ages = sprintf("%g-%g", min(ab$Age), max(ab$Age)), n_shared_timepoints = nrow(oab),
      r_curves = r_vaf, r_speed = r_speed, r_measured = r_obs,
      direction_1 = net_direction(ab$VAF1), direction_2 = net_direction(ab$VAF2),
      max_VAF_1 = max(oab$AF1), max_VAF_2 = max(oab$AF2),
      max_cell_fraction_sum = max(2 * oab$AF1 + 2 * oab$AF2), must_overlap = max(2 * oab$AF1 + 2 * oab$AF2) > 1,
      max_abs_z = max(abs(oab$z)), within_read_noise = all(abs(oab$z) < 2),
      first_detection_gap_years = abs(first_detect(tr[i]) - first_detect(tr[j])),
      cluster_1 = cl$cluster[match(tr[i], cl$traj_id)], cluster_2 = cl$cluster[match(tr[j], cl$traj_id)])
  }
}
pairs <- bind_rows(pair_rows) %>%
  inner_join(ids %>% select(ID, SHCS_ID_new), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(size_ratio = pmin(max_VAF_1, max_VAF_2) / pmax(max_VAF_1, max_VAF_2),
         parallel = !is.na(r_curves) & r_curves >= 0.5 & !is.na(r_speed) & r_speed >= 0.3 & direction_1 == direction_2 & direction_1 != "flat",
         divergent = (!is.na(r_curves) & r_curves <= -0.5 | !is.na(r_speed) & r_speed <= -0.3) & direction_1 != direction_2 & direction_1 != "flat" & direction_2 != "flat",
         call = case_when(
           parallel & size_ratio >= 0.5 ~ "parallel, similar size (putative co-clonal)",
           parallel & size_ratio < 0.5 ~ "parallel, nested sizes (putative subclone or co-expanding)",
           divergent ~ "divergent (putative competing)",
           first_detection_gap_years >= 5 & !is.na(r_curves) & r_curves >= 0.5 ~ "sequential (second variant appears later)",
           TRUE ~ "unclear")) %>%
  select(-parallel, -divergent) %>%
  relocate(SHCS_ID_new) %>%
  arrange(as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new)), variant_1, variant_2)
knitr::kable(pairs %>% select(-ID, -traj_1, -traj_2) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))))
table(pairs$call)
cat("\nPairs in which the two variants must share cells (2 VAF1 + 2 VAF2 > 1 at a timepoint):", sum(pairs$must_overlap),
    "\nPairs with measured VAFs within read noise at every shared timepoint:", sum(pairs$within_read_noise), "\n")
tableS5 <- pairs %>%
  transmute(Participant = SHCS_ID_new, `Variant 1` = variant_1, `Variant 2` = variant_2, `Shared ages` = shared_ages,
            `Shared timepoints` = n_shared_timepoints, `r curves` = round(r_curves, 2), `r speed` = round(r_speed, 2), `r measured VAF` = round(r_measured, 2),
            `Direction 1 / 2` = paste(direction_1, direction_2, sep = " / "), `Max VAF 1 / 2 (%)` = sprintf("%.1f / %.1f", 100 * max_VAF_1, 100 * max_VAF_2),
            `Max |z|` = round(max_abs_z, 1), `Within read noise` = ifelse(within_read_noise, "yes", "no"),
            `Max sum of cell fractions` = round(max_cell_fraction_sum, 2), `Gap of first detection, years` = first_detection_gap_years,
            `Cluster 1 / 2` = paste(cluster_label_map(cl)[as.character(cluster_1)], cluster_label_map(cl)[as.character(cluster_2)], sep = " / "), Call = call)
write_res(tableS5, "tableS_cooccurring_pairs.txt", paper_copy = TRUE)
write_res(pairs, "figS6_pairs_full.txt")
```

# 2. Three individuals per pattern (not a display item of the paper)

Colours are the genes of the paper; the protein change is written at the end of each curve. Points: measured VAF
(filled circle: Mutect2 call; triangle: variant reads in the pile-up; open circle: not detected, LoD / 2). Dashed line: 2%.

```{r examples, fig.width=13, fig.height=10}
used <- c()
pick <- function(pattern, n = 3) {
  cand <- pairs %>% filter(grepl(pattern, call), !ID %in% used) %>% arrange(desc(abs(r_curves)), desc(n_shared_timepoints)) %>% distinct(ID) %>% head(n) %>% pull(ID)
  used <<- c(used, cand)
  cand
}
patterns <- c("parallel, similar size (putative co-clonal variants)", "divergent (putative competing clones)", "nested or sequential (putative subclone or later variant)")
# the divergent pattern is picked first because its individuals also carry parallel pairs
ex <- bind_rows(tibble(ID = pick("divergent"), pattern = patterns[2]),
                tibble(ID = pick("similar size"), pattern = patterns[1]),
                tibble(ID = pick("nested|sequential"), pattern = patterns[3])) %>%
  inner_join(ids %>% select(ID, SHCS_ID_new), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(pattern = factor(pattern, levels = patterns))
knitr::kable(ex)

panel_of <- function(d) d %>% inner_join(ex, by = c("ID", "SHCS_ID_new")) %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(as.character(group_genes(Gene.refGene)), levels = gene_levels), Gene = fct_recode(Gene),
         gene_colour = ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% names(gene_colors), Gene.refGene, "Other"))
pm <- panel_of(pred_m)
om <- panel_of(multi)
ends <- pm %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% filter(Age == max(Age)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(change = sub("^[A-Z0-9]+ ", "", label))
genes_in_fig <- names(gene_colors)[names(gene_colors) %in% unique(pm$gene_colour)]   # one legend for the three rows
fig3_pattern <- function(pat) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = filter(pm, pattern == pat), aes(x = Age, y = VAF, group = traj_id, colour = gene_colour), linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = filter(om, pattern == pat), aes(x = Age, y = AF, colour = gene_colour), size = 2.3, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_text_repel(data = filter(ends, pattern == pat), aes(x = Age, y = VAF, label = change, colour = gene_colour), size = 3,
                    direction = "y", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 1.2, segment.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~SHCS_ID_new, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colors, name = "CHIP gene", breaks = genes_in_fig, limits = genes_in_fig) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
    labs(x = "Age", y = "VAF (clone size)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 13), legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2, size = 2.3)))
}
p_rows <- map(patterns, fig3_pattern)
# three examples of the patterns (Figure S6 shows all individuals)
p_3 <- wrap_plots(p_rows, ncol = 1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") & tag_theme
save_extra(p_3, "cooccurring_examples", 13, 11)   # not a display item of the paper
p_3
```

# 3. Figure S6: all individuals with several trajectories

```{r figS-all, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
pa <- pred_m %>% mutate(SHCS_ID_new = factor(SHCS_ID_new, levels = ids$SHCS_ID_new), gene_colour = ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% names(gene_colors), Gene.refGene, "Other"))
oa <- multi %>% mutate(SHCS_ID_new = factor(SHCS_ID_new, levels = ids$SHCS_ID_new), gene_colour = ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% names(gene_colors), Gene.refGene, "Other"))
ea <- pa %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% filter(Age == max(Age)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(change = sub("^[A-Z0-9]+ ", "", label))
p_all <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pa, aes(x = Age, y = VAF, group = traj_id, colour = gene_colour), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = oa, aes(x = Age, y = AF, colour = gene_colour), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = ea, aes(x = Age, y = VAF, label = change, colour = gene_colour), size = 2.7, direction = "y", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 1,
                  segment.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~SHCS_ID_new, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colors, name = "CHIP gene", breaks = names(gene_colors)[names(gene_colors) %in% c(gene_levels, other_genes)]) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "VAF") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
save_supp(p_all, "FigS6_cooccurring_all_individuals", 14, 12)
p_all
```

pairs %>% count(call) %>% mutate(share = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n / sum(n))) %>% knitr::kable()
pairs %>% filter(within_read_noise) %>% select(SHCS_ID_new, variant_1, variant_2, max_abs_z, call) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2)
